scope: Read-only static map of accepted two-ETF cash events to frozen shared-account and dated-order definitions; zero network, market, prices, account, return computation or old-file modifications.
plain_language_conclusion: 已验分红公告给了计划支付日，但没有钱实际到账的时刻。若登记日有持仓，账本先列应收；原带日期实现须有可花时点依据才能释放。未来独立研究也可事前固定双方相同的保守到账时序，但必须写明这是研究假设，不能冒充历史实际到账或倒填旧输入资格。周一00:00是250元入金锚点，通常的组合决策在最近完整周末收盘后；仅有计划支付日不能把分红算入该周可花现金。旧跨周测试没有证明同日两个未完成真实决策争用现金。

pay_date_shape_summary.same_week_decision_relation: The listed Monday00:00 values are weekly 250-yuan deposit anchors, not universal decision_at. Regular planning uses the most recent completed weekend close; Monday deposit itself can also trigger a new-money arrangement. Pay date alone cannot prove dividend cash available at either relevant decision/freeze.
pay_date_shape_summary.later_monday_relation: Next Monday is a calendar/deposit anchor only; it is neither necessarily the next decision nor proof that dividend cash is available. Actual decision/freeze time must be bound by the future run.

frozen_spec_and_implementation_links.read_scope: lines32-40,46-54: weekly 250 deposit at Monday00:00; normal planning after latest completed weekend close, with Monday deposit able to trigger new-money arrangement; receivable is asset not free cash; record/effective/pay sequence; P0 residual next scheduled decision; P1 sale proceeds only after available.

specific_execution_questions.exact_unknown: Scheduled pay date exists; actual free-cash credit timestamp does not. Dated ledger requires aware pay_at and source/declared scenario clock.
specific_execution_questions.when_material: Only if record-date shares exist and a later decision or order freeze might use the distribution. Four scheduled Monday payment dates coincide with deposit anchors, not necessarily decision times; other dates can affect later frozen orders if still live.
specific_execution_questions.minimum_resolution: Original dated implementation needs an aware pay_at with evidence appropriate to the claim. A future independent research contract may instead pre-freeze one conservative availability rule for both P0/P1 and label it an assumption, never historical actual credit; do not retroactively qualify old inputs or modify old event dates.

specific_execution_questions.affected_operation: P1 sale then later buy; P0/P1 fixed opening when a dividend record/effective/pay clock falls after decision
specific_execution_questions.existing_behavior: order_planning_v2 ActionContext rejects any event clock crossing decision-to-opening; later_buys inherits original action coverage and does not silently refresh target/price.
specific_execution_questions.when_material: Only a generated decision/opening span that actually crosses a named event; event dates alone do not prove an order exists.
specific_execution_questions.minimum_resolution: In formal research contract, define supported action-to-order transition/expiry or reject that exact opening and wait next weekly decision; do not silently use a post-decision dividend in old immutable budgets.

specific_execution_questions.affected_operation: buy/sell on a planned 09:30 open and daily valuation
specific_execution_questions.known_exact_exception: 159915 official suspension on 2021-02-08 and 10:30 resumption on 2021-02-09, source in dated_gap_readback; known limit-boundary refusals already recorded.
specific_execution_questions.why_not_event_specific_new_source_now: None of the 12 accepted 510300 scheduled pay dates coincides with the named 159915 February 2021 restriction dates or named 2015-07-08/2024-10-08 boundary dates. This does not establish all other openings.
specific_execution_questions.minimum_resolution: Bind exact planned opening dates and two-product status/price-limit evidence in future run contract, and only investigate a named uncovered opening if generated orders require it; no blanket all-stock notice scan.

specific_execution_questions.affected_operation: two weekly decision batches that could both retain live orders or sale-funded later buys on the same opening
specific_execution_questions.existing_behavior: cross-week accepted engineering fixture has two frozen buy batches with previous week completed before next; fixed order is whole fill or terminal refusal, no chase. P1 later_buys may schedule a future opening but full automatic P0/P1 lifecycle/expiry across weeks is unimplemented.
specific_execution_questions.minimum_resolution_if_triggered: After the final policy generates a concrete overlapping opening with two live decisions, specify lifecycle and a deterministic global cash reservation/priority and verify it; do not treat this conditional engineering branch as a third current user decision.
